📋 Submission Requirements
All projects must use the Google Gemini model. Each team must submit the following by 2:30 PM sharp:
One-Pager — Document describing your team and idea

Hosted Prototype — Working demo link (via Google AI Studio & Google Cloud Run)

Why Attend?
🏆 Compete for up to $5,000 in first/second/third place cash prizes, advisory meetings with leading healthcare AI operators and industry sponsors, and 1:1 pitch opportunities with PearX, NEA, and Cathay

Healthcare is the largest industry in the world, yet much of its infrastructure still runs on fragmented software, manual workflows, and administrative overhead. Recent advances in foundation models and AI agents have created an opportunity to rethink how healthcare is delivered, from the clinician desktop to the insurance back office to the patient experience.
Life sciences is entering a similar inflection point, as advances in foundation models, biological data, and increasingly automated experimentation begin to reshape how we understand and engineer biology. From target discovery and molecular design to clinical development, AI is creating new ways to compress the traditional drug development cycle and build entirely new categories of therapeutics and research tools.
Throughout the day you'll work directly with venture investors, startup founders, physicians, and operators who spend every day building healthcare companies.
Teams will leave with relationships, recruiting opportunities, and potentially the foundation for their next startup.
Whether you're already building in healthcare or just discovering the space, you'll spend the day working on problems that matter.
What Should You Build?
Build something that meaningfully improves health.
We're less interested in incremental AI wrappers and more interested in products that unlock new capabilities, create new business models, or solve long-standing problems across the healthcare and life sciences ecosystem.
Some areas we're especially excited about include:
🧬 Care Delivery & Clinical Innovation
Build AI that makes care more accessible, personalized, and effective , from diagnostics and specialty care to home-based care, clinical trials, robotics, and entirely new models of care delivery.

🏥 Healthcare Infrastructure & Financing
Build AI that fixes the systems behind healthcare , improving how care is financed, administered, coordinated, and delivered across providers, payers, employers, marketplaces, and supply chains.

🔬 AI × Life Sciences
Build AI that better predicts what will actually happen in biology , using richer, multi-compartment data to model real-world outcomes such as toxicity, delivery, efficacy, and clinical trial endpoints rather than focusing only on molecular binding.

These are examples, not constraints. If you have a compelling idea that improves healthcare, feel free to build it because we want to see it!

About Event

Build open agents that work together

The Collaborative Agent Hackathon is a one-day event for building open-source, collaborative AI agents with Flower .
Agents are changing what’s possible. We’ll explore how they can achieve more by working together safely in human-supervised multi-agent teams.
You’ll form a team on the day, build a working prototype, and demo it at the end of the event. Projects can range from simple agent collaborations to more complex systems that delegate tasks, share context, and coordinate their work.
You don’t need an existing team or a fully developed idea. Bring your laptop, your interests, and a willingness to collaborate.

The event is generously supported by Nebius , which is providing all compute resources for the hackathon, sending expert technical mentors and judges, and contributing to the prize pool.
The hackathon challenge
Build an open-source agent or multi-agent system with Flower that puts safe, human-supervised collaboration at the heart of the solution.
Your project could bring agents together to:
Automate a real-world task

Form self-improving loops through feedback and iteration

Work across distributed machines and datasets

Flower simplifies building multi-agent systems, with support for distributed coordination, collaborative learning and inference, and privacy-aware deployment. It is built with an open-source community of more than 7,000 users worldwide.

Projects from all industries and application areas are welcome — including scientific research, healthcare, finance, content/media production, education, public services, software development and entirely new forms of human-agent collaboration.

Participants register individually.
Teams of two to four people will be formed during the morning, unless formed earlier . The organisers will help participants find teammates with complementary interests and experience.
Already know your team? Please provide your teammates’ names when registering.
Bringing an idea is optional.
Eligibility: Everyone is welcome, including builders from startups and companies, as well as students, researchers, and postdocs from all universities.
Awards and judges
Teams will compete for a prize pool worth more than US$5,000 , with awards presented after the final demos to recognize outstanding projects.

connect models to action

Universal Hackathon - Create Your Own AI Workforce | AWS Builder Loft
The Universal Celebration Hackathon is a celebration of creativity, entrepreneurship, and the next generation of AI-powered companies. Bring your ideas, experiment with new possibilities, and turn your vision into something real.
This hackathon is about more than building a prototype. It’s about imagining what a company looks like when AI agents can work together as a team.
The Challenge
Build a company run by a team of AI agents.
Your challenge is to create an AI-native business or startup where multiple specialized agents work together to build, operate, and grow the company.
Think of your agents as your founding team. You might have a CEO agent defining strategy, a product agent building the product, engineering agents writing code, marketing agents finding customers, sales agents closing deals, finance agents managing the business, and operations or customer-support agents keeping everything running.
The key question is:
What happens when you give an AI team a business to run?

What to Build
Build a working prototype of a company powered by a team of collaborating AI agents.
Your project should:
Identify a real problem or opportunity.
Define a clear product, service, or business.
Create multiple AI agents with distinct roles and responsibilities.
Show how your agents communicate, collaborate, and make decisions.
Demonstrate how the agents can actually execute business tasks.
Show how your company could acquire customers, deliver value, and grow.
You can build for consumers, businesses, creators, communities, or any other audience.
Don’t just build an AI feature. Build the beginnings of an AI-native company.
Tracks
Choose one or multiple tracks and build your company within them.
Climate, Sustainability & Impact
Build AI solutions for a healthier planet and stronger communities.
Examples: climate, sustainability, agriculture, disaster response, smart cities, social impact.
Health, Wellness & Care
Build AI solutions that improve health, wellbeing, and quality of life.
Examples: healthcare, fitness, nutrition, mental wellness, elder care.
Education, Learning & Research
Build AI solutions that make learning, education, and research better.
Examples: tutoring, personalized learning, professional training, research, career development.
Business, Growth & Productivity
Build AI solutions that help businesses work smarter, grow faster, and operate better.
Examples: sales, marketing, CRM, analytics, productivity, automation, business operations.
Media, Entertainment & Creators
Build AI solutions for creativity, entertainment, and digital experiences.
Examples: film, music, gaming, content creation, creator tools, social media.
Commerce, Retail & Consumer
Build AI solutions that transform how people shop and how businesses sell.
Examples: e-commerce, marketplaces, retail, logistics, inventory, personalized shopping.
Build the Future
Whether you're creating a climate startup, an AI health company, an education platform, a new media studio, or an autonomous business operating system, the goal is the same:
Build a company where a team of AI agents can turn an idea into reality.
Come celebrate, build, experiment, and show us what the future of business looks like.

About Event

Car AI Navigation Hackathon

Challenge: We have a mini city road with lanes, intersection and traffic signs. Your job is to use AI and a small autonomous car like the Donkeycar or equivalent (typically 1/16th scale or smaller RC car with a Raspberry Pi or equivalent and a camera controlling it) to navigate the "city", obeying signs and making it from one side to the other in the fastest time.

You must bring your own car, which should be ready to run, with compute and camera already onboard and working. The objective of the hackathon is to add AI "city" navigation to it.

You can use onboard AI, AI on your laptop via Wifi or AI in the cloud to help with the navigation. Think creatively about what kind of AI to use and what's the fastest way to do it!

This is not an event for spectators, nor will cars be provided to those who arrive without one. This is a hackathon, not a regular race. Come ready to hack!
